product.olivetti-m4-564-s.summary: The PCI M4 with i486DX2 · 66 MHz in the Slim Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.history: Olivetti included this model in its professional M4 Modulo range. The M4-5x4 shared its platform with the PCS D4/100 and came in two case sizes.
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.architecture: Networking can be integrated. The BA2197 and BA2205 boards have an AM79C970 Ethernet controller. The guide lists 256 KB of L2 cache for this model.
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 13
product.olivetti-m4-564-s.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.25 · Update 1.
